title: Accepting Payments and Redemption on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Methods.** The care center takes payments on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement by the class's phone payment methods — credit card, debit card or a one-time debit from a bank account. Cash and money orders are taken only at the facility office.

**Statuses.** Payments are accepted while the rental is in active, delinquent, lien noticed, auction scheduled, moving out or vacated status. While the rental is delinquent a payment of any amount is accepted. Once a lien notice has been sent, a payment is accepted only if it pays the full balance due, including lien-process fees; a smaller payment is declined and nothing is posted. Partial payments while delinquent follow the class's partial-payment setting, and the full-balance requirement after a lien notice follows the class's settings for partial payment after a lien notice and for redemption.

**Redemption.** When a payment brings the balance due to zero or below on a delinquent, lien noticed or auction scheduled rental, the rental is redeemed and returns to active, its delinquency date is cleared, and where the company overlock is on, an overlock-removed step is recorded. A redemption is not possible once the lien sale has been held.

**Returned payments.** The former returned-payment clause is no longer in force: "When the bank returns a payment for insufficient funds or a closed account, the payment is reversed in full and the class's returned-payment fee is posted against the reversed payment; a card chargeback is reversed without that fee." It has been superseded by the current returned-payment fee basis. A reversal that leaves rent from a period past its grace period unpaid makes the rental delinquent again under the late-fee rule.

## Acceptance table

| Rental status | Payment smaller than the balance due | Payment of the full balance due |
|---|---|---|
| active, moving out, vacated | accepted | accepted |
| delinquent | accepted | accepted; the rental is redeemed |
| lien noticed, auction scheduled | declined, nothing posted | accepted; the rental is redeemed |
| sold at lien sale, reserved, reservation cancelled | not an accepting status | not an accepting status |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A lien noticed rental owes $412.00 including lien-process fees; a $300.00 payment is declined and nothing is posted; a $412.00 payment is accepted, the rental returns to active and its delinquency date is cleared.
- A delinquent rental owing $180.00 under company overlock receives a $200.00 payment: the balance falls to a $20.00 credit, the rental is redeemed and an overlock-removed step is recorded.
- A tenant offers a money order by phone: it is not taken by the care center; money orders are taken only at the facility office.

superseded_clauses: When the bank returns a payment for insufficient funds or a closed account, the payment is reversed in full and returned_payment_fee_usd is posted against the reversed payment; a card chargeback is reversed without that fee.
